name: Ningen Hokanko
source:
His next workplace, which was "initialized," was a power plant.
Transvitality, Human Power Plant.
His job is to manage the energy source "Archaic humans".

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/5805]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
接受“初始化”后，他的下一个工作地点是一座发电厂。
Transvitality公司旗下的人类发电厂。
他的工作，是管理这里的能源——“旧人类”。
